exposure: number of persons in the household
cohort: 768 mothers recruited shortly after delivery at the University Medical Center Ulm, Germany between 04/2012 and 05/2013
finding: Maternal hair cortisol in the last trimester of pregnancy is determined by many factors, including delivery mode, body mass index and season of delivery.
mod_finding: Primary C-section was associated with lower HCC compared to spontaneous delivery.
